section_heading: Data Movement and Conversion Instructions: mov
exact_quote:
mov.type  d, a;
mov.type  d, sreg;
mov.type  d, avar;       // get address of variable
mov.type  d, avar+imm;   // get address of variable with offset
mov.u32   d, fname;      // get address of device function
mov.u64   d, fname;      // get address of device function
mov.u32   d, kernel;     // get address of entry function
mov.u64   d, kernel;     // get address of entry function

.type = { .pred,
          .b16, .b32, .b64,
          .u16, .u32, .u64,
          .s16, .s32, .s64,
                .f32, .f64 };
reason_for_inclusion: Exact syntax variants of scalar mov. The form mov.type d, a; establishes the two-operand ordering d, a; .b32 is listed in the scalar mov type set.
